commenti.body:
Hi, everyone, I'm looking for scenes from movies that have similar plot content to this one from [Before the Devil Knows You're Dead](https://youtu.be/4a55PnIKoz0?si=tjJIkZJMqS1gYO1W), where two characters debrief after a heist (or similar crime) goes wrong.

I'm struggling to find any so thanks for any help!

There was an absolute masterclass version of this scene in Heat - the scene in the diner where Robert Deniro's character confronts Waingro after he fucks up the heist. Not much is said but it's incredibly menacing and suspenseful.

**Dune: Part Two (2024)**

Finally got around to this. I watched the first part when it came out about two and a half years ago but haven't rewatched it since (I don't rewatch movies). This experience has really put me off from watching multi part films until all parts are out simply because it is too hard to remember what happened when the second part comes out years later. Movies like this really need a recap at the beginning.

Anyway, besides that, movie is excellent. I liked the SyFy miniseries from the early 2000s but this felt like if that miniseries actually had a massive budget. Acting was good, writing was good, effects, etc. I think the movie has a lot of interesting things to say about how power corrupts as well as how religious fervor can lead people down a dangerous path. I think in general what Paul was doing was a good thing since the Harkonnens were clearly bad people but then I started to feel a bit uncomfortable when Paul >!embraced being a messiah.!< I think it is supposed to make me feel uncomfortable though and question whether that was the right move or not.

Anyway, would recommend so long as you watch both parts in close proximity to one another.
Thank you! I'll check that out.
